about: A full intake call for Denver Lang, the sample patient, following the call plan: one question each about the goal, health and reminders, with no follow-up questions, then a goodbye that ends the call. Each turn has both sides and the notepad after it. The simulated call test speaks Denver's lines and checks the transcript, the notes and the proposed notebooks against this script.

turns.agent: Hi, I'm Stellis. I'll ask three quick questions, about your goal, your health and reminders, and take notes you can edit. First, what's the main health goal you'd like help with?
turns.person: Keeping the weight off. I've lost about eight kilos since April last year, and I'd like my knees to stop hurting on the stairs.

notes.heading: Goals
items: Keep the weight off, after losing about 8 kg since April 2024

turns.agent: Eight kilos is real progress. Next, your health: which conditions do you have, and which medicines do you take?
turns.person: Type two diabetes and high blood pressure, since the eighties. Metformin five hundred in the morning, lisinopril, and simvastatin at night.

notes.heading: Goals
items: Keep the weight off, after losing about 8 kg since April 2024

turns.agent: Thank you. Last one: would any reminders help, and when?
turns.person: A reminder to weigh in on Monday mornings would help.

notes.heading: Goals
items: Keep the weight off, after losing about 8 kg since April 2024

turns.agent: Thanks, Denver: you want to keep the weight off and ease your knees, you manage diabetes and blood pressure, and you'd like a Monday weigh-in reminder. You can edit your notes, then press Continue to add your records. [END]
